title: Apply to Sell Your Music Catalog — Free Evaluation (2026) — SPACE
description: Request a free music catalog review. Start with your email and artist or label name; we follow up privately for income and rights documents. No obligation.
paragraphs: SPACE reviews revenue-generating catalogs directly across genres. Ambient, sleep, focus, meditation, wellness, lo-fi and electronic music are examples. Every catalog is assessed individually.
Start with your email and artist or label name. We request the relevant income and rights documents privately by email after you apply. No upload is needed now.
